requirement.evidence: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions. Housing providers will consider applicants on a case-by-case basis.
requirement.note: Blanket ban, case-by-case review, and the excluded categories are supported. The document says a conviction more than 5 years old is not considered, but also lists exceptions (direct relationship to housing, unreasonable risk, current criminal behavior) that the card omits. 'Ask for ... offer evidence of rehabilitation' is advice, though the document does list rehabilitation as a factor.
